verdict.rationale: Recurly documents usage-based add-ons that track measured units and bill at the end of each cycle. Nothing in the evidence shows real-time display of current-cycle usage or accrued cost to customers or staff, and nothing shows usage thresholds or pre-invoice alerts. End-of-cycle metering and billing is an adjacent capability, not the visibility-and-alerting story asked for.

support.subject: As an ops user, customers and my team can see current-cycle usage and accrued cost in real time, with thresholds and alerts before an invoice surprises anyone
